name: Twenty
description: Twenty is a modern, open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce—fully customizable, affordable, and powered by the community.
label: The #1 open-source CRM
content_zh: Twenty 是一个现代化的开源CRM系统，可以替代Salesforce。它完全可定制，价格实惠，并且由社区驱动。

name: FlashDocs API
description: FlashDocs lets you generate Google Slides and PowerPoint decks from your product — using just one API call. Markdown, charts, images, tables, merge tags, brand themes — all handled. Build it once, export stunning decks everywhere.
label: Custom Google Slides & PowerPoints via AI-powered API
label_zh: 通过AI驱动的API定制Google幻灯片和PowerPoint演示文稿
content_zh: FlashDocs 可以让你通过一次 API 调用，从你的产品生成 Google Slides 和 PowerPoint 幻灯片。无论是 Markdown、图表、图片、表格、合并标签还是品牌主题，都能轻松处理。只需构建一次，就能在任何地方导出精美的幻灯片。

name: Middleware
description: Middleware is a YC backend full-stack AI observability platform that helps developers detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in real time—automatically. By providing deep insights across your entire stack, you ensure optimal performance and reliability for AI-powered applications.
label: Full-Stack Cloud Observability
content_zh: Middleware 是一个 YC 后端全栈 AI 可观测性平台，能够帮助开发者实时自动检测、诊断和解决问题。通过提供整个技术栈的深度洞察，它确保了 AI 应用程序的最佳性能和可靠性。

name: NativeMind
description: NativeMind brings the latest AI models to your browser—powered by Ollama and fully local. It gives you fast, private access to models like Deepseek, Qwen, and LLaMA—all running on your device.
label: Your fully private, open-source, on-device AI assistant
label_zh: 您的完全私密、开源、设备端的AI助手
content_zh: NativeMind 将最新的 AI 模型带到你的浏览器中，由 Ollama 提供支持，并且完全在本地运行。它让你能够快速、私密地访问像 Deepseek、Qwen 和 LLaMA 这样的模型，所有这些都在你的设备上运行。

name: Rumora
description: Rumora.ai finds viral content in your niche and helps you mention your startup naturally in the comments. As videos take off, users read these comments and visit your website, converting at a rate 3x higher than average. Try it for 7 days, risk-free.
label: Get seen by target users automatically in YouTube comments
label_zh:
直译：
在 YouTube 评论中自动被目标用户看到

意译（保持原有格式）：
在 YouTube 评论中自动吸引目标用户的注意
content_zh: Rumora.ai 会帮你找到你所在领域的热门内容，并在评论中自然地提及你的初创公司。随着视频热度上升，用户会看到这些评论并访问你的网站，转化率比平均水平高出三倍。你可以免费试用7天，毫无风险。

name: UXArmy
description: UXArmy takes the pain out of user research for Product and Marketing teams.  Test your mobile app, website, prototype, and run customer surveys on UXArmy.  Let AI assist you with test analysis and task creation.  Supported by an in-house global user panel because we know recuritment can be a pain.
label: AI powered UX research
content_zh: UXArmy 让产品和市场团队的用户研究变得轻松。你可以在 UXArmy 上测试移动应用、网站、原型，并进行客户调查。让 AI 帮助你分析测试结果并创建任务。我们还提供内部全球用户小组支持，因为我们知道招募用户是一件麻烦事。

name: Warp
description: Warp is the agentic development environment, built for coding with multiple AI agents.
label: The first agentic development environment
content_zh: Warp 是一个面向多 AI 代理的开发环境，专为与多个 AI 代理协作编码而设计。

name: Wobo AI
description: Meet Wobo: Your AI-powered job search assistant. Automating applications and finding matches tailored to your skills, Wobo makes job hunting effortless.
label: Your Personal AI Recruiter - Automate your job search
label_zh: 你的个人AI招聘助手 - 自动化你的求职过程
content_zh: 认识一下Wobo：你的AI求职助手。它能自动提交申请，并根据你的技能找到合适的职位，让找工作变得轻松简单。

name: Airtable
description: The AI-native app platform, combining the magic of vibe coding business apps with real production-readiness and scalability.
label: AI-Native App Platform
content_zh: AI原生应用平台，结合了业务应用程序的动态编码魔力，同时具备真正的生产就绪性和可扩展性。

name: Hope AI
description: Build maintainable, production-grade applications. Control generation at component-level with prompts and design sketches. Compose with design system and reusable components. Deploy instantly. Generate code that developers love! By Bit Cloud.
label: Architect agent that builds professional software
label_zh: 构建专业软件的架构代理
content_zh: 构建可维护的、生产级别的应用程序。通过提示和设计草图在组件级别控制生成。使用设计系统和可重用组件进行组合。即时部署。生成开发者喜爱的代码！由Bit Cloud提供。

name: ElevenLabs
description: The most realistic text to speech and voice cloning software. The most compelling, rich, and lifelike voices for creators and publishers seeking the ultimate tools for storytelling.
label: Create natural AI voices instantly in any language
label_zh:
直译：
即时创建任何语言的自然AI语音

意译（保持原有格式）：
立即生成任何语言的自然AI语音
content_zh: 最逼真的文本转语音和声音克隆软件。为寻求终极叙事工具的创作者和发布者提供最具吸引力、丰富且栩栩如生的声音。

name: rabbit
description: rabbit is an AI startup rethinking how humans and machines interact. We're building an AI-native operating system, formed around robust cross-platform agentic capabilities and custom hardware that gives people access to the latest AI.
label: re-imagining the future of human-machine interaction
label_zh: 重新构想人机交互的未来
content_zh: rabbit 是一家 AI 创业公司，致力于重新定义人与机器的互动方式。我们正在构建一个原生的 AI 操作系统，该系统具备强大的跨平台代理功能，并配备定制硬件，让人们能够轻松使用最新的 AI 技术。

name: Mighty
description: Mighty brings enterprise-grade security to AI agents. Drop in our client-side Python SDK to spin up a data vault, secure key exchange and an OAuth-ready policy engine in minutes. Agents can now access private data with full auth, audit and compliance.
label: OAuth for agents
topics_zh: 安全软件，身份验证与身份管理工具
content_zh: Mighty 为企业级 AI 代理带来了安全保障。只需几分钟，通过集成我们的客户端 Python SDK，即可搭建数据保险库、安全密钥交换和一个支持 OAuth 的策略引擎。这样，AI 代理就可以在确保授权、审计和合规的前提下访问私有数据。

name: timeOS
description: timeOS is the AI that sits in on your calls & meetings, and completes next steps using expert agents, automatically.
label: Cursor for calls & meetings
content_zh: timeOS 是一种人工智能，它会参与你的通话和会议，并自动使用专家代理来完成后续步骤。

name: PulseAI
description: Pulse turns your data into dashboards and answers. Connect a database, upload a CSV, or use one of many integrations and Pulse builds charts, KPIs, and insights in seconds. Just ask your data. No complex BI tools, no setup. Built for fast-moving teams.
label: From raw data to charts in seconds with AI
label_zh: 从原始数据到图表，几秒钟内由AI完成
content_zh: PulseAI 可以将你的数据转换成仪表板和答案。无论是连接数据库、上传 CSV 文件，还是使用多种集成方式，PulseAI 都能在几秒钟内生成图表、关键绩效指标和洞察。你只需向数据提问，无需复杂的 BI 工具，也无需繁琐的设置。它专为快速行动的团队设计。
